name: Klaxoon
description: Connect Klaxoon MCP to Claude to read, summarize, organize, and update Klaxoon whiteboards, helping teams prepare workshops, structure ideas, and turn board content into actionable outputs.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Klaxoon to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Klaxoon to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.klaxoon.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Klaxoon MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Klaxoon provides these MCP tools: create_whiteboard, create_whiteboard_items, create_whiteboard_sticky_color, delete_whiteboard_items, delete_whiteboard_sticky_color, get_mcp_server_instructions, get_whiteboard_info, list_whiteboard_items, list_whiteboard_sticky_colors, list_whiteboards, update_whiteboard_items, and update_whiteboard_sticky_color.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Klaxoon?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Klaxoon in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Klaxoon requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Klaxoon is developed by Klaxoon by Wrike, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
